messages:
samir: Evening handoff — quick SLO/alerts check, leaving notes before I go offline in ~20m. p50/p95 look fine but saw a tiny bump in p99 for text-gen on gpool-2.

lina: saw that earlier, dug into batcher queues. backlog spiked for ~3m at 18:04 UTC during a small canary. likely autoscaler cadence + a bursty customer.

maria: pushed a small debounce change in alerts PR #789 to reduce noise from transient 5xx, PTAL? it's low-risk, tests pass.

samir: thanks. @maria I'll review in a few. if it looks good let's merge before midnight so canary runs overnight.

alert-bot: Pager created: p99-textgen-latency-fanout (severity: low). 3 occurrences in last hour. Link: https://alerts.redwood.example/p/1234

thinh: I can take the pager if it fires again. I'm oncall tonight. quick checklist for whoever inherits: 
- check autoscaler metric: `queue_size` on gpool-2
- check batcher backlog: `batcher_backlog{pool="gpool-2"}`
- warmup KV caches for hot-models: `curl -XPOST https://ops.redwood/run-warmup`

samir: leaving a small runbook note I just edited: 
```
Runbook: text-gen p99 latency spike
1) check autoscaler logs: `kubectl logs -n infra autoscaler-gpool-2`
2) verify queue growth in last 15m: grafana/dashboard/queues
3) if backlog > 500 and sustained >5m -> scale to 4x and notify infra
4) if error rate > 0.5% -> rollback recent deployment (see last deploy tag)
```

lina: added a note about KV eviction — we saw evictions coinciding with the spike. maybe reduce eviction sensitivity for next 24h.

maria: merged minor debounce tweak, will monitor. leaving a quick breakpoint in the alert rule so it doesn't page on <2 occurrences per 10m.

thinh: acked. I'll pre-warm the hot keys for the overnight window in 10m. leaving command here in case someone else is oncall: `./scripts/kv_preheat --pool gpool-2 --model text-gen-v3`

samir: one blocker: I couldn't repro the batching regression locally; might be workload-specific. if it recurs tomorrow please dump `batcher_stats` from the node and attach to the thread.

lina: noted. I'll add a short synthetic test to reproduce the pattern in staging and link results here.

maria: tiny logistics: FYI I'm OOO tomorrow morning until 11am, ping me after for followups.

thinh: thanks. any other quick asks before you sign off @samir?

samir: nope, that's it. leaving the handoff checklist in the runbook and tagging this thread in the handover doc. good night folks :wave:

alert-bot: auto-note: runbook updated by samir at 2026-03-17T19:11:23Z

maria: night :zzz:

lina: thanks all :thumbsup:
